verdict.rationale: dlt provides a supported REST API source framework with declarative config for pagination/auth, plus dlt-init-openapi to generate connectors from OpenAPI specs, and a general Python-based custom source/resource framework (dlt.pipeline) that doesn't require forking the library — all documented as first-class, supported workflows for long-tail APIs. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for building many custom connectors ('code around a thousand new data sources each month'). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically for a long-tail/niche API (not just well-known APIs), and no low-code GUI builder beyond the OpenAPI generator/CLI.
